title: MNCDS 0.1 development obligation record
description: Machine-readable development obligation owned by MNCDS. Pressure discovered during family execution is projected into this form (see docs/obligation-projection.md) so it enters the same lifecycle as ChangeSet work: open -> resolved/rejected, evaluated at the MNCS promotion boundary. An obligation record is a process claim, never a conformity verdict.

obligation_key.description: Stable identity for this obligation; duplicates within one evaluation set are contradictory.

required.description: Whether an open obligation blocks promotion evaluation. Optional open obligations stay visible but do not decide.

commit.description: Exact candidate commit this obligation was raised against. An obligation never promotes a different revision.

kind.description: Where the obligation came from. evaluation-gap marks missing authority semantics (UNKNOWN by construction).

resolution.description: Present when status is resolved or rejected. rejected with authoritative evidence is a negative finding.

evidence.description: Evidence references (digests, paths, URIs) supporting the current status.

supersedes.description: Previous obligation_key this record replaces; convergent pressures link, never silently merge.

extensions.description: Namespaced owner extensions; transport must ignore unknown keys.
